name: CEPF Mountains of Central Asia Biodiversity Hotspot grants
summary: CEPF's 2026 to 2031 investment in the Pamir and Tien Shan hotspot, focused on priority species, Key Biodiversity Areas and conservation corridors; a call for proposals has been announced, with details due 20 November 2026.
